fact: Finance minister Peggy Serame said BURS continues to optimise e-services including online customs declarations.
Serame said BURS's Systems Connectivity and Data Exchange programme with Zambia, for customs and tax data, was completed in May 2023.
system: BURS-ZRA Systems Connectivity and Data Exchange

fact: BURS's Principal Officer for Customs Reforms says a new integrated Customs Management System replaced ASYCUDA++ in 2017 and clears declarations after online payment through the declaration processing platform.
BURS says the CMS provides a Single Window through its Other Government Agencies module, with the Botswana Bureau of Standards enrolled and other agencies at testing stage.

BURS says its CMS exchanges data with the South Africa Revenue Service and the Zambia Revenue Authority under WCO Data Model and Unique Consignment Reference arrangements, with Zambia exchange part of the One Stop Border Post project.
